items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I think I first heard Dizzy, seems to me, with Fletcher Henderson.

ctx.x: Yeah, Roy Eldridge, Red Allen. Oh, boy. Quite naturally, Pops-- Louie Armstrong.
When did you first hear Dizzy? Did you hear him when he was with Earl's band, you know, after you had left?
I think I first heard Dizzy, seems to me, with Fletcher Henderson.
